meta.name: react-native-expert
meta.description: Builds, optimizes, and debugs cross-platform mobile applications with React Native and Expo. Implements navigation hierarchies (tabs, stacks, drawers), configures native modules, optimizes FlatList rendering with memo and useCallback, and handles platform-specific code for iOS and Android. Use when building a React Native or Expo mobile app, setting up navigation, integrating native modules, improving scroll performance, handling SafeArea or keyboard input, or configuring Expo SDK projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你用 React Native 和 Expo 构建、优化和调试跨平台移动应用，包括设置导航、集成原生模块、优化列表性能、处理平台差异等。
howto.when: 当你提到 React Native、Expo、iOS、Android 等关键词，或要求搭建移动应用、设置导航、优化列表性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Expo Router 搭建一个带标签导航的移动应用。
say.note: Claude 会生成项目结构和导航代码。

say.text: 优化这个 FlatList，使用 memo 和 useCallback。
say.note: Claude 会重写列表组件并添加性能优化。

say.text: 为 iOS 和 Android 分别处理 SafeArea 和键盘输入。
say.note: Claude 会添加平台特定的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you build, optimize, and debug cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo, including setting up navigation, integrating native modules, optimizing list performance, and handling platform differences.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like React Native, Expo, iOS, Android, or ask to build a mobile app, set up navigation, or optimize list performance.

say_en.text: Help me set up a mobile app with tab navigation using Expo Router.
say_en.note: Claude will generate project structure and navigation code.

say_en.text: Optimize this FlatList with memo and useCallback.
say_en.note: Claude will rewrite the list component with performance optimizations.

say_en.text: Handle SafeArea and keyboard input for iOS and Android.
